causality_conclusion: At H+epsilon the Forecast API can return a row valid at H, and preceding-hour accumulations refer to the completed [H-1,H] interval. The probe does not establish a fixed availability SLA or frozen-model training/live semantic parity.
training_source_metadata_limitation: Historical downloader does not pass a models parameter or persist selected model/vintage per record. Existing feature specification uses the word observed although its input is Archive reanalysis, not station ground truth.
recommended_training_source_note: For a future model with Forecast API predictors, pin a source/vintage intended to align with live forecasts (Open-Meteo Historical Forecast API is documented for that use) and document the target/reference source explicitly.
